title: AI coding assistants: what the 2026 data really shows
takeaways: 90% of software professionals now use AI (Google DORA 2025)
46% of developers distrust AI output accuracy (Stack Overflow)
Experienced devs took 19% longer with AI in METR's study
81% spend more time reviewing AI-generated code (Harness)
90% of fully governed teams report major gains vs 44% (Black Duck)
source_note: Sources: DORA 2025; Stack Overflow 2025; METR; Harness; Black Duck 2026
